In detail

A large, mostly residential outer district near Budapest Airport. A June 2023 district safety comparison named District XVIII among Budapest's comparatively safe districts, and it does not appear in the July 2025 citywide theft-hotspot map or in any burglary, violent-crime, or nightlife-disorder hotspot list checked for this build. Sources checked: BPhirek.hu, 1 Jun 2023 (comparatively safe districts).
